answer: Anchor each agent identity to one verifiable professional license — a physician, attorney, or engineer listed in a public licensing-board registry. Like a beacon fixed in a nebula of lookalike accounts, one license vouches for exactly one agent, so forging ten thousand sybils means passing ten thousand board exams and surviving ten thousand background checks. The voyage from applicant to licensed professional takes years, pricing mass fakery out of reach. The limit is exclusion: most people hold no such license, so it must sit beside other paths.
